headline: Jair Bolsonaro Hospitalized In Brasilia With Abdominal Pain
metaDescription: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro was admitted to the DF Star Hospital in Brasilia on Friday following reports of severe abdominal pain.
aiSummaryBullets: Former President Jair Bolsonaro was admitted to the DF Star Hospital in Brasilia on Friday.
The hospitalization followed reports of severe abdominal pain and distension.
His son, Senator Carlos Bolsonaro, confirmed the medical admission after the former president experienced sudden health complications.
aiContextParagraph: Former President of Brazil Jair Bolsonaro was admitted to the DF Star Hospital in Brasilia on Friday, November 20, 2026, after experiencing severe abdominal pain and distension. Bolsonaro, who is currently under house arrest while serving a prison sentence related to alleged coup attempts, was evaluated by his private physician before being transported for further medical attention. News of his hospitalization was confirmed by his son, Senator Carlos Bolsonaro. The former president has a history of abdominal complications, which have been frequently monitored since he suffered multiple stab wounds in the past. While reports indicate he is currently receiving treatment, his son has expressed concern regarding both his father's medical status and the environment of psychological pressure he is facing during his ongoing legal proceedings. The medical staff at the facility is currently managing his symptoms.
whyItIsViral: The event is being tracked by four independent news outlets, reflecting significant interest in the health of the former Brazilian president amidst his ongoing legal issues.
